public_entry_policy: Only the adopted command family exposes Nia-owned administrative actions; no public nia/niactl/missionctl compatibility aliases. Internal SDKs and workers are implementation details.
external_software_policy: Independent external software retains its own commands and authority. No compatibility wrappers for systemd, networking, device or storage tools.
response_policy: Reference-equivalent behavior, stdout/stderr, exit status, prompts, tabular and machine-readable output, and interactive navigation are required per adopted command. Current grammar tests do not establish response compatibility.
review_scope: Installation/update concept chapters, package command references, interim-fix intake, license and prerequisite helpers, missing-command lookup, comparison and authorization cross-references. This is a scoped review, not an exhaustive inventory of every operating-system utility. Ordinary package construction, generic media copying and diagnostic template/message cross-references were also reviewed; some command-level details and entire unrelated OS families remain outside the completed review.
